integrity: The result is proved analytically from the published SVT recurrence. Exact-rational replay checks the activation, contraction, rank-staircase, and finite-settling formulas; finite tests are corroborative rather than substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to matching observation patterns and constant steps with \(0<\delta<2\). It does not establish rank monotonicity for general matrix-completion patterns with coupled singular directions, and finite termination is asserted only for \(\delta=1\).
title: Exact rank staircase and finite-termination resonance for SVT on matching samples
